issues.where: cloud deck and Great Red Spot
issues.what: the swirls are soft and airbrushed, and this stop is about half as sharp as the other
issues.fix: rebuild the belts with fine filaments so the brush strokes disappear

issues.where: cloud deck and Great Red Spot, crops A and I
issues.what: at native size the bands still read as combed paint, with flat light and no cloud-top relief
issues.fix: add small-scale turbulence and shadow between cloud layers

issues.where: right-hand night limb, crops C, E, and G
issues.what: the dark edge is a hard mask and the stars are cut off in a clean arc
issues.fix: add a faint rim of scattered light and soften the occlusion

issues.where: right-hand night limb, crops E, G, and Q
issues.what: the same hard cutout against the Milky Way, with no haze on the unlit limb
issues.fix: carry a thin atmosphere around the night edge

issues.where: Io and its shadow, crop A
issues.what: Io is a soft painted sphere and the shadow is a flat black oval that ignores the clouds
issues.fix: break the umbra over cloud height and sharpen Io, with a little bounce light

issues.where: Io and its shadow, crop I
issues.what: the moon and the oval shadow are softer and just as flat
issues.fix: use the same relief and penumbra treatment as the other stop

issues.where: left sunlit limb, crops B and D
issues.what: the atmosphere clips to a thin white rim instead of a wide falloff
issues.fix: widen the haze and pull the highlight back from white

issues.where: sky crops F and H, and the Milky Way in C
issues.what: brighter stars are soft discs a few pixels across
issues.fix: tighten the point spread so bright stars stay points
